THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 01 / OCTOBER 2026
MODERN PROPORTION
046
62 / Khaki Bubble
Newsboy Cap
A khaki double-breasted top with puff sleeves, a pointed collar
and a keyhole neckline, worn with a matching bubble-hem mini
skirt and a cream newsboy cap. Long black waves, rosy blush and
a patterned top-handle bag with a leopard-fur charm.
63 / Polka Cable
Layered Romance
A beige polka-dot shirt with a long neck tie layered under a
rose-taupe cable-knit corset vest, worn with a pleated knit mini
skirt trimmed in crochet lace and a dark leather tote. Long
honey-brown hair with a small hair clip against a soft
sand-colored wall.
